verdict.rationale: The homepage advertises a "team of Forter Agents" (forter-docs-12), a thin first-party hint at built-in AI assistance. The documented natural-language capability (reviewing decisions, managing disputes, updating policies) comes through Forter's MCP server connected to an external client such as Claude Desktop (forter-docs-9, forter-docs-20), not an assistant inside the Forter console. missing for 10: documented in-console AI assistant, natural-language querying of fraud data within the console, AI-drafted rules, investigation summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
